govdocs-archive_org-nsia-BusinessExecuti: This Business Executives Move for Vietnam Peace item — First National... — is a file on the antiwar business group. The file belongs to the political archive. Business leaders joined the peace cause. The item is a fragment of protest history.
monsieur-de-pourceaugnac: Molière's boisterous farce torments the provincial Monsieur de Pourceaugnac with Parisian trickery — scheming doctors, lawyers, and disguises conspire against the pompous visitor. Broad, brilliant comedy from the master's middle period. Laughter at the expense of vanity, pretension, and provincial pride.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antoine-de-la: This 1913 reference article on Cadillac — the founder of Detroit. Joseph Roy tells his bold career. He planted the French flag on the strait. The motor city bears his name. The Gascon who built an empire. His strait post became a great city.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-barac: A 1913 entry on Barac — Barak, Deborah's general. Francis Albert tells his Judges tale. He routed Sisera's iron chariots. The song of triumph crowned the day. The warrior of the prophetess. His victory song is Scripture's gem. His tribe was Naphtali's own.
